description: Secondary facts on one line ("Acme Cloud · Remote"). Max two items per line so long strings in other languages never wrap mid-line; more facts go in more rows. The `hds/max-two-meta-items` lint rule enforces the same limit on bullet-joined text in JSX; it cannot see chains built in code (`[a, b, c].join(' · ')`), so those rely on this type and review.

usage.when: Show one or two secondary facts on a single line, joined by a bullet ("Acme Cloud · Remote").
usage.whenNot: Three or more facts, or labelled key-value pairs.

useInstead.reason: second MetaLine row per extra fact, or MetadataList for labelled pairs
